skill.name: longbridge-research
skill.description: Research stocks with Longbridge market data, analyst ratings, forecasts, shareholder ownership, insider trades, short interest, industry peers, and investment workflows.
skill.summary: Build equity research briefs from Longbridge market data and structured investment templates.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, CLI examples, and prose terms such as fetch, system, and symbol. I found no Ruby backtick execution, fetch API code, or reconnaissance behavior in the cited static locations. A semantic privacy issue remains because account holdings and watchlist access is documented in a workflow while the top-level skill claims public no-login usage.

remediation.suggestion: Update the top-level metadata and documentation to state which workflows require Longbridge authorization and read holdings or watchlist data.
Add a rule that holdings and watchlist data must not be sent to WebSearch or external services unless the user explicitly requests it.

remediation.issue: Local CLI command safety is implicit
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to validate ticker symbols and flags, avoid shell interpolation, and request confirmation before running local Longbridge commands.

semantic_findings.title: Undeclared Account Data Access
semantic_findings.description: The top-level skill says all CLI commands are public and no login is required, but the finance calendar workflow requires Longbridge authorization and retrieves holdings and watchlist data. This mismatch can surprise users because brokerage holdings and watchlists are sensitive financial data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines explicitly claim public/no-login commands while another workflow requires authorization and retrieves holdings and watchlist data. The risk is disclosure and consent mismatch, not inferred malware behavior.

content.value_statement: Investors need organized market data before making research decisions. This skill turns Longbridge data into analyst-style stock research and portfolio context.
actual_capabilities: Routes analyst ratings, forecasts, consensus, finance calendar, shareholder, fund holder, insider, short interest, and peer requests to focused references.
Uses Longbridge CLI guidance for stock symbols, output formats, language options, and error handling.
Builds stock research snapshots with consensus, financial highlights, valuation, price performance, and news.
Supports investment proposal, coverage initiation, competitive analysis, thesis tracking, and post-investment monitoring workflows.
Covers DeFi yield and on-chain research with WebSearch fallback where Longbridge data is unavailable.
Provides bilingual response rules for English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
limitations: Requires the Longbridge terminal or an MCP fallback for many data retrieval tasks.
Some workflows reference account authorization when portfolio, holdings, or watchlist data is needed.
Financial outputs are research support only and do not provide investment advice.
Live DeFi and on-chain metrics may require WebSearch because Longbridge does not provide all protocol data.

use_cases.title: Create an Equity Brief
use_cases.description: Generate a concise stock snapshot with consensus, valuation, price performance, recent news, and balanced investment considerations.

use_cases.title: Track Market Events
use_cases.description: Summarize upcoming earnings, dividends, IPOs, macro events, and possible impacts on followed securities.

use_cases.title: Monitor Investment Theses
use_cases.description: Compare new financial data, news, and analyst changes against an existing thesis or post-investment plan.

prompt_templates.title: Research One Stock
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a concise Longbridge research snapshot for NVDA.US. Include consensus, valuation, price performance, and key risks.

prompt_templates.title: Check Analyst Sentiment
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare current analyst ratings and target price trends for TSLA.US. Explain what changed and what data is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor Portfolio Events
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize upcoming earnings, dividends, IPOs, and macro events that could affect my Longbridge holdings this week.

prompt_templates.title: Build Investment Memo
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an investment proposal for AAPL.US with thesis, valuation context, catalysts, risk scenarios, and evidence gaps.

output_examples.output: A concise equity brief with company snapshot, valuation context, analyst consensus, recent price action, news themes, and balanced bull and bear points.
A holder summary showing major institutions, ownership changes, fund exposure, available dates, and missing fields.
A calendar report that groups earnings, macro events, dividends, IPOs, and market themes by date and relevance.

best_practices: Confirm ticker and market suffix before requesting data.
Ask for source dates and missing fields when using research outputs.
Treat outputs as research context, not investment advice.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill for direct buy or sell instructions.
Do not assume portfolio workflows work without Longbridge authorization.
Do not mix Longbridge data with unsourced third-party claims.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It supports research and analysis. It does not submit orders or provide direct buy or sell instructions.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Public market data may work without login. Portfolio, holdings, watchlist, and planning workflows may require Longbridge authorization.

faq.question: Can it analyze non-US stocks?
faq.answer: Yes. The references cover US, HK, SG, CN, and crypto spot symbols when supported by Longbridge.

faq.question: What data does it use?
faq.answer: It focuses on Longbridge CLI or MCP data, with WebSearch fallback for DeFi, on-chain, and limited missing fields.

faq.question: Can I use it in Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this investment advice?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are for reference and should be checked before financial decisions.
